items.title: Hippocampal campaign ASSAY A: access mechanism at a frozen interface -- receiver-state-conditioned bridge vs retrieval / routing / frame rivals across a bandwidth ladder (Gates A0-A2)
items.note: DIAGNOSTIC (excluded from governance confidence/conflict scoring); claim_ids DELIBERATELY EMPTY per the V3-EXQ-1002/1010 lineage convention, bears_on ARC-139 MECH-537/538/540/547/548 INV-105 (context only). Implements Gates A0/A1/A2 of REE_assembly/evidence/planning/hippocampal_campaign_assay_specifications_20260910.md (sections 1, 2, 4) over FROZEN endpoints (no ree_core change, no agent). | QUESTION (spec 2.1): does a receiver-state-CONDITIONED transformation add held-out consumer use beyond good retrieval, fixed routing and frame conditioning at matched budget, and is any gain attributable to sender content? | REDESIGN AFTER RED-TEAM BLOCKING (2026-09-16): the first draft fitted every bridge by MSE to the native field, so the receiver-state block A4 is manipulated on was exactly independent of the fit target and A4 collapsed onto A1 while the frame bit went to A3 alone (C1 unattributable). Fixed by (1) an END-TO-END consumer-use objective through the frozen heads (the bridge loss IS the section 1.6 metric; heads frozen) and (2) making BANDWIDTH the section 1.3 budget axis: every arm is a [msg;cond]->tanh(M)->25 bridge, M swept over 1,2,3,4,5,6,8,12,16,25; a design probe (seed 42) showed A4 >> A1 only below the unconditional bridge's sufficiency width (M<=3) and A4 == A1 above it, so a single pre-registered M would make C1 an artefact of that integer. | PRE-REGISTERED: two evaluation widths chosen IN-RUN on the selection block (block 2) by rule: m_suff(arm) = narrowest M with block-2 elevation over the strongest trivial predictor >= 0.20; M* = min over rivals {A1,A2,A3,A5,A6}; M_A4 = m_suff(A4). C1b (load-bearing, the spec's estimand) = A4 minus best rival at M* on block 3 by the section 1.6 paired rule (mean>=0.05 AND >=2SD, >=2/3 seeds). C1a (load-bearing, bandwidth regime) = M_A4 < M* on >=2/3 seeds. C2 = A7_receiver_only < 0.80 (structurally expected pass, declared). Gate A2 at M_eval: C3 A4 minus A4-state-permuted positive by the paired rule; C4 head-delivery permutation costs < 0.05; C5 A1 message state-invariance (integrity, exactly 0); C6 spec conjunction (A7 high AND D_joint-D_sender>0.05) -- the draft's unconditional clause was structurally failing; C7 closed-loop ENV rollouts through the interface (head 0, q0), step-20 agreement >= strongest trivial; foraging competence (rung 7) recorded. Gates G1-G10 in-run (G5 against the re-measured strongest trivial = max(prev action, per-query constant) = ~0.42 on this 3-query task, not 1002's 0.58). | DV-SYMMETRY: per arm declared in the docstring; bandwidth M is a rank change, not a logit broadcast (DV moves >0.3 across the grid in the probe). | Step 2.4 GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout = frozen-consumer agreement through a conditional bandwidth-limited bridge under a broken frame; checked 1002/1008/1010 manifests (rung-2 decoder argmax only, no bridge, no conditional arm, no bandwidth axis) -> not recoverable, run. | Step 2.5c: no OPEN corrupting substrate_queue entry overlaps (no REEAgent); degrading overlaps recorded: mech357-freeze-incompatible-pressure-mechanism, SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING (causal_grid_world.py), dv-dynamic-range-precondition-class (_metrics.py). | Smoke: --self-test PASS; --dry-run PASS end-to-end (toy scale self-routes G9 red = substrate_not_ready_requeue, the correct reading for 3-pass heads); POST-FIX full-scale confirmers (--scratch-out, ~675 s/seed on DLAPTOP; all gates G1-G10 green, no arm gate red, no fit diverged, 3 restarts/cell selected on block 2, driver-stratified blocks): seed 42 M*=3 (best rival A5 0.690) M_A4=4, C1b delta -0.165, C1a delta +0.014, state-permutation cost 0.069; seed 43 M*=M_A4=3 (best rival A5), C1b=C1a delta +0.020, state-permutation cost 0.015. Both seeds self-route conditional_access_earns_nothing_at_any_bandwidth (the direction the prior favours); the DV moves >0.3 across the M grid on every arm (dose-sweep non-saturation confirmed); A6 (8-way k-means selector) non-functional at every width; A7 0.29-0.38; C7 (closed-loop, 30 episodes) fails on both seeds. Full run: 3 seeds x 10 widths x 7 arms x 3 restarts + controls + 6 closed-loop policies x 2 widths x 30 episodes; ~35 min on DLAPTOP. | red-team pass 1 (opus, first draft): BLOCKING -- every finding dispositioned in the docstring. red-team pass 2 (opus, on the redesign): CONTESTED, 8 findings, every one verified against the source and FIXED -- F1 blocks confounded with the episode driver (fit all-oracle, test all-random) -> driver-stratified split asserted in-run; F2 C1a an ordinal crossing with no variability discipline (one A4 draw vs min over 5 rivals; init seeds correlated across widths) -> C1a is the paired section-1.6 contrast at M_A4, ordinal saving kept as a diagnostic; F3 best-rival identity chosen on the test block -> chosen on block 2; F4 C7 survivor-denominated on 3-10 episodes vs a mismatched bar -> every started episode counts, alive fraction recorded, closed-loop q0 bar on the policy's own trajectory, 30 episodes; F5 C4 could not fail -> C4 is now A5 minus best unconditional arm, head-delivery permutation kept as a diagnostic; F6 rivals-nonfunctional refused as instrument failure -> refuse only when neither A4 nor any rival is functional; F7 C2/C5 structurally-expected passes serialised load-bearing -> load_bearing False; F8 G4 bit-identical to G3 -> inverse routed as a module through the fitted-arm path; plus a DV-denominated cond_reaches_committed_action precondition from the reviewer's note. Not iterated to CLEAR. | Gate A3 (frame x query factorial) and ws250_pca32 replication deferred to a successor per spec 2.6/2.9. Sibling V3-EXQ-1046 (SD-082) is a separate chip.

items.title: SD-082 successor (H1-trained-discriminating-readout): the first CONSEQUENCE-TRAINED lateral_pfc rule readout -- with modulatory selection authority ON and gated_policy OFF during P1, does the trained readout change E3's top preference (argmin) MORE than the same substrate's frozen-init readout, tick for tick on the same yoked observation stream (per-seed paired exact test, minimal effect 0.05)?
items.note: DIAGNOSTIC (excluded from governance confidence/conflict scoring). The SD-082 successor routed by CONFIRMED failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1027-1029-cluster_2026-09-14 (applied by governance 2026-09-15, REE_assembly beb47bca09) off V3-EXQ-1029 -- registry leg H1-trained-discriminating-readout under a CHANGED training regime: the first SD-082 run with lateral_pfc_rule_readout_consumer=True AND use_modulatory_selection_authority=True during P1, so the head's output enters the selection whose outcome REINFORCE credits. New EXQ NUMBER, no supersedes: 1029a is refused BY NAME in the autopsy's release_basis, and 1029 is a confirmed load-bearing PASS that nothing here invalidates. P1 budget 300 from failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1028_2026-09-15 (status awaiting_human_confirmation -- cited as PROVISIONAL; this run records its own per-half update/flip-tick profile, measured at 1020's pre-update point, so the budget is re-readable in its own regime). | DESIGN: per seed five yoked runners on private torch/numpy/random streams, all stepped on the reference's observation: TRAINED_INTACT (reference, drives env, head REINFORCE-updated), TRAINED_ABLATED (same head, rule_state zeroed for compute_bias), INIT_INTACT / INIT_ABLATED (head held at P0-end weights), REF_SELF (bit-identical twin). Head state_dict mirrored into the trained siblings after every update; agents are never deep-copied. On every score tick where all four pair runners are fresh and both pairs raw-identical, a joint 2x2 table is accumulated: b = trained pair diverges in argmin(post-bias scores) and init pair does not, c = the reverse, n = all such ticks; paired DV per seed = (b-c)/n. gated_policy OFF on all five runners (the autopsy's authority_channel_confound control) and R7 MEASURES that the readout is the sole modulatory contributor (E3 composite modulatory range vs the head's own bias range per fresh tick); modulatory_authority_gain 0.5 (1029's, so the init pair is comparable to 1029's banked on_pair; the 2.0 prior art disposed of in the docstring); NO magnitude arm -- and under authority the applied modulatory range is normalised per runner, so the DV is a bias SHAPE comparison, stated as such. Seeds = 5 lineage [611,622,633,644,655] + 2 FRESH [666,677], a pre-registered factor (C3). P0=60, P1=300, SCORE=60 at 48 steps. E3 never commits in this configuration (committed_fraction 0.0) so the DV is E3's TOP PREFERENCE, not an executed action; sampled-action divergence recorded per pair. | CRITERIA (per-seed paired exact test, adjudicated over READY seeds, SEED_MAJORITY 4 of 7 ABSOLUTE, ONE effect bound M = MIN_EFFECT_OF_INTEREST 0.05 for all three so they partition each seed's outcome): C1 (load-bearing) P[Bin(b+c,1/2)>=b] < 0.05 AND DV >= M on >= 4 seeds AND mean DV >= M -> PASS/supports; C1neg (routing) the mirror at -M -> FAIL/weakens (training reduced the readout's consequence; per-seed c1neg_reachable = init reach inside the joint table >= M is recorded, since DV >= -init); C4 (routing) two-sided equivalence -M < LB95 and UB95 < M on EVERY ready seed AND |mean DV| < M, evaluated only when neither C1 nor C1neg fired -> FAIL/weakens (label distinguishes a significant sub-M advantage from no detectable advantage); otherwise FAIL/unknown (inconclusive or heterogeneous; sign, per-seed p-values, bounds, run and episode counts recorded). C2 (trained pair >= 0.02 on a majority) is RECORDED, not load-bearing -- proved implied by C1 under R5; C3 (a FRESH seed among the C1-clearing seeds) refines a PASS only. combination_rule in the manifest. Readiness PER SEED via experiments/_lib/precondition_gate.py: R1 self-yoke 0 divergent; R2 INIT head flip >= 0.01 (the trained head's flip fraction is a RESULT, recorded); R3 authority active >= 0.5 on the two INIT runners (all four recorded with an equality flag); R4 joint paired n >= 50 (all four runners fresh AND all four raw score vectors identical -- the two pairs on the same raw landscape; mismatches counted); R5 init reach INSIDE the joint table >= 0.02 (1029's DIV_FLOOR, comparator '>=' explicit); R6 >= 200 updates AND head_move_l2 > 1e-6; R7 sole-channel relative difference <= 1e-3 with post-authority exploration channels counted as misses. MIN_READY_SEEDS 4; fewer = refusal with a record whose label names the dominant red gate (R5 -> substrate_not_ready_requeue; fewer than 4 seeds RUN -> insufficient_seeds_run) and whose summary states exact per-seed counts; interpretation.preconditions carries green seeds only when adjudicated, with the library's scope note at the key the indexer reads (the V3-EXQ-785 rule). | Step 2.4 GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout = paired trained-minus-init argmin divergence with consumer=True and authority ON; the cluster autopsy searched the ~50 ARC-062/GAP-B authority-trained drivers (none with the SD-082 consumer) and the whole 822*/1020/1027/1028/1029 lineage (authority OFF) -> not recoverable, run. 1029's recorded on_pair (0.2615/0.0271/0.0144/0.0821/0.1155) reused as the design-time feasibility prior. | Step 2.5/2.5a: consumer flag, authority flag and the compute_bias / select_action / lateral_pfc.update hooks all reachable at runtime (scale probes below). | Step 2.5b re-derive brake: consumer count for SD-082 = 3 (822b/822c/822d) >= 2; NOT braked -- both producer autopsies stamp fired=false with literal_count_meets_threshold=true (explicit release: none of the counted readings is a substrate_ceiling, no build is owed), and three skill exemptions apply independently (new EXQ number, changed manipulation/regime, diagnostic discriminating WHY). | Step 2.5c: SD-082 substrate_queue entry is corrupting with substrate_paths [] (emptied by governance 2026-09-09, recorded UNCHANGED by both autopsies) -> cannot fire; no open corrupting entry with a populated path names e3_selector.py or lateral_pfc_analog.py; DEGRADING entries on this footprint recorded: SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING, mech357-freeze-incompatible-pressure-mechanism (causal_grid_world.py); the authority flag is implemented_pending_validation and is the MANIPULATED variable, disclosed as such. | Ethics all-false/allow (SENT-0). | DV-SYMMETRY per arm: DV = paired argmin-divergence difference, invariant under a constant broadcast across candidates and a monotone rescale of the whole score vector; the ablation changes the head's INPUT through a nonlinear per-candidate MLP (R2 measures the flip on the init head; a trained head whose bias has become a broadcast is what C1neg/C2 read out), head_effect changes its WEIGHTS (R6 asserts they differ), the self-yoke carries no manipulation; authority is NOT a symmetry of this DV (it rescales the modulatory vector, not the whole score) and the design no longer claims it is -- it fixes the applied modulatory RANGE per runner, which is why the comparison is one of shape. | Sample size: 1029's _choose clears e3.last_* before every select_action and gates fresh on it; n_fresh per runner, per-pair raw-identical counts and the joint n recorded; runner summaries are score-phase only. REINFORCE surrogate is 1020's log_softmax(-bias/T) over the head's own output, unchanged -- a negative weakens H1 AS OPERATIONALISED BY THIS LINEAGE'S PROCEDURE; the surrogate form stays a named residual alternative (config.reinforce.surrogate). | SCALE PROBES (seed 611, p0=12 p1=25 score=20 at 24 steps): pre-redesign 552 s -- R5 init pair 12/60 = 0.20 GREEN (the readout DOES reach E3's argmin in this regime), trained pair 0/60, trained head flip 0.00 vs init 0.115, authority scale median 131, committed_fraction 0.0, 25 updates; post-redesign 452 s -- joint b=1 c=11 n=60, paired DV -0.167, p_neg 0.0032, UB95 -0.079 (c1neg_seed True), init 0.183 / trained 0.017 / head_effect 0.867, INIT flip 0.125, trained flip 0.00, R7 sole-channel rel diff 0.0 median and max on 60 ticks, authority active 1.0, 24 updates (R6a red at probe scale only), head_move_l2 0.266, every other gate green. Probe-driven changes before the red-team: crash fix (the H-learning-signal-sign statistic unpacked 1020's 3-tuples as pairs; invisible to the dry run, which reaches no update); explicit comparators on every precondition (the indexer's inclusive default would recompute an R5 reading of exactly 0.0 as met). | red-team pass 1 (opus): BLOCKING, 17 findings -- F2-A C2 implied by C1 under R5 (FIXED: C2 demoted, unreachable null-table row removed); F2-B/F2-C the across-seed-SD null margin made the trained-collapses-to-zero negative unreachable at the banked prior (CV 0.99) and degenerated to the absolute floor at low SD (FIXED: replaced by the per-seed paired exact test; legacy margin recorded only); F3-A `weakens` stamped on a positive near-miss (FIXED: sign-aware grid, C1neg / C4 / unknown); F4-B all-seeds readiness vs majority criteria (FIXED: per-seed gates, MIN_READY_SEEDS 4, green-only adjudication list); F1-B authority divides out magnitude and the docstring's scalar-rescale symmetry argument was false (FIXED in prose: shape comparison); F1-C sole channel asserted not measured (FIXED: R7); F1-D surrogate still the imitation form (SCOPED); F1-E "committed preference" false (FIXED); F1-F raw-identical filter vacuous under yoking (FIXED prose); F1-G P1 flip measured post-update (FIXED: pre-update hook); F3-B refusal prose (FIXED: counts); F3-C C3 vacuous + blanket non-degeneracy (FIXED: C3 = fresh-seed-reproduces, applies on PASS only; per-criterion); F3-D console verdict (FIXED); F4-A (resolved by F2-B's fix); F4-D R3 provenance (NOTED); F1-A/F4-C CLEAN. Self-test now executes 9 synthetic grid branches (PASS main / lineage-only / weakens-reduced / weakens-equivalence / unknown / PASS on 4 ready of 7 / R5 refusal / R6 refusal / 3-significant-seeds-not-PASS) before any compute. | red-team pass 2 (opus): CONTESTED, 14 findings, no BLOCKING -- all fixed or dismissed in writing (docstring RED-TEAM RECORD): F-1 C1/C4 not exclusive and F-3 C1 floor below the minimal effect (FIXED: one bound M for C1/C1neg per seed and mean, two-sided C4; exclusivity swept exhaustively in the self-test); F-2 C4 seizable by strongly negative seeds (FIXED: universal over ready seeds, |mean| < M, after C1/C1neg; the F-2 shape now routes unknown); F-4 R5 '>0' at n~300 admitted C1neg-blind seeds and F-5 R5 on the wrong denominator (FIXED: R5 inside the joint table at 1029's 0.02; c1neg_reachable per seed); F-6 independence statistics dropped (FIXED: 1029's run stats restored, joint runs + episode counts, min discordant on clearing seeds); F-7 C4 non-degeneracy (DISMISSED with note: R5-on-joint guarantees init reach on every ready seed); F-8 scope note not at the indexer's key (FIXED); F-9 realised-n refusal routing and untested gate_red (FIXED: insufficient_seeds_run branch + grid cases); F-10 cross-pair raw landscape (FIXED: required, mismatches counted); F-11 R7 blind to post-authority channels (FIXED: active-flag check); F-12 hook fires in the REINFORCE replay (FIXED: captures cleared per step); F-13 R3 gated on trained runners (FIXED: INIT only); F-14 title carried the withdrawn margin (FIXED). Clean checks 1-9 recorded. No third pass (one re-spawn permitted, spent after pass 1). Self-test now executes 13 grid branches + the exclusivity sweep.. | Smoke on the final driver: --dry-run PASS end-to-end (self-test 13 branches, `Seed S Condition C` boundary, `ep N/M` with M=p0+p1+score, per-seed `[seed]` line + one `verdict:` line per seed, manifest relocated, sentinel emitted); at dry scale (1 seed) it correctly self-labels insufficient_seeds_run. validate_experiments.py --strict OK, 0 warnings, no exemption markers; validate_recording.py --strict on the dry manifest OK (33 flat readout scalars, criteria carry measured+threshold, comparator on every precondition, scope note present, arm_fingerprint reuse_eligible). ASCII 0 violations. Post-pass-2 scale probe: 749 s, every gate green except R6a (24 updates vs the 200 floor that 300 P1 episodes reach): joint b=1 c=11 both=0 n=60, init reach inside the joint table 0.183 (R5 >= 0.02), paired DV -0.167, p_neg 0.0032, LB95/UB95 -0.255/-0.079 (c1neg_seed True, c1neg_reachable True, equivalence False), the 11 c-ticks in 9 runs across 9 distinct episodes (not clustered), cross_pair_raw_mismatch 0, post_authority_channel_ticks 0, R7 0.0 median and max on 60 ticks, authority active 1.0 on all four runners (equal), head_move_l2 0.266, INIT flip 0.125, trained flip 0.00, |bias| trained 0.012 vs init 0.023, committed_fraction 0.0.. | Runtime: probe-calibrated ~950 min on darwin-arm64 for 7 x 420 episodes; 1000 min queued. | Authored by science-batch4-20260915-exq-1046 (metaworker Orchestrator, died on the 2026-09-16 weekly limit mid red-team); resumed, redesigned and queued by busy-goodall-364bc0 (chip-20260916-resume-exq1046-sd082-consequence-readout-queue).
